text:
anya: Quick sync request — we need to prioritize Autoscale policy phasing for Dedicated reserved pools. Lumos and Zephyr asked for smoother burst handling + clear SLA bands. Can we align on launch criteria and a phased rollout plan by EOD Fri?

sam: +1. Short context: current autoscale only does hard preemption + backfill. No soft-burst window or credits today.

matt: Proposal sketch:
1) Beta opt-in for 3 customers with soft-burst (30s default) and detailed telemetry.
2) Soft spillover w/ tenant cap and carryover credits prototype.
3) GA with SLA tiers (standard/guaranteed) + billing for burst overage.

carla: Need concrete gating metrics before beta -> latency/error/cost gates. Suggest: p95 latency <= 200ms for small gen requests, error_rate < 0.5%, burst_success_rate >= 99%. Also need customer-facing FAQ about preemption behavior.

dinesh: Ops checklist: surface tenant throttles & preemption notices in Console, add alerts for unplanned evictions, and publish an oncall runbook for soft-burst failures.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for branch "autoscale-phased" scheduled Tue 03:00 UTC.

sam: Gating draft (will add to spec):
```
Gating:
- latency_p95 <= 200ms (24h window)
- error_rate < 0.5%
- unplanned_evictions <= 5/day across beta tenants
- >=3 pilot customers running for 72h
```

anya: OK — I'll spin up a spec PR and a prioritization card. Who owns canary/monitoring? @matt?

matt: I can own canary + dashboards. Will need ~0.5 FTE Q2 for dashboards/alerts and one engineer for policy integration during beta.

carla: Sales ask: Lumos wants explicit preemption notice + crediting language in SLA. We'll need legal copy for beta offers.

dinesh: Also add tenant-level config docs: preemption windows, credit accumulation, and eviction visibility. Ops wants API hooks for graceful drain.

sam: One more product constraint: autoscale policy must be mutable per-pool via API/Console (no hard-coded defaults). That enables customers to opt into aggressive or conservative burst behavior.

anya: Action items captured:
- matt: dashboards & canary ownership
- sam: policy API changes + config surface
- carla: customer commit language & sales playbook
- dinesh: runbook + console telemetry
I will draft a 3-phase timeline and post the PR today.

carla: :thumbsup:

matt: noted — will create Grafana tabs and SLOs this week.

anya: thanks all — will follow up with the spec link and a quick sync invite.
